_help: One entry per product built by Oduma Corp. Each one gets a card on the homepage (#products), a card on /products/, a link in the footer, and its own page at /products/<slug>/. Fields: slug, name, category, status (e.g. Live, Beta, Coming soon), tagline (one line for cards), summary (page intro), cover (image in company/public/img/products/, 1200x750 is ideal), icon (sprite name), website, buttons [{label, url, style: solid|ghost}], features_title, features [{icon, title, text}], art (optional HTML file in src/products/ for the hero picture; default is the cover), extra (optional HTML file in src/products/ placed after the features), demo (true loads the USSD simulator script), try_label (text for the card's second link, e.g. 'Try the demo').
